decision: No additional kinetic simulations are commissioned by this review.
rationale: The predefined seeds 1/2 requirement applies to flagged numerical refinements; those original refinements were completed and adjudicated. These nine cases are the separately prescribed one-factor kinetic screen.

Material kinetic flags are retained and disallow a blanket robustness or parameter-adequacy conclusion. The present retained kinetic statements report exact finite-configuration observations and explicitly state N1. They do not use a marginal sign to assert a general mechanism or favorable response.

The small background-loss target differences are not interpreted directionally. The unflagged 2D growth screen is not declared insensitive because its full curve lies above all baseline curves and its 6 h difference exceeds 60.

Further stochastic or numerical kinetic checks would be needed before claiming replicated magnitudes, general signs, convergence, or numerical equivalence of altered biological hypotheses. Such a claim requires a specific bounded decision before new execution; it is excluded here.
The central comparison of both ratios and all three representations remains in scope with its actual numerical dependence. These TE2-only alternatives do not validate TE5 kinetic robustness.
